candidates.architecture: Llama-style Causal Transformer (30 layers, 9 hidden heads, RoPE, SwiGLU)
candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Highest feasibility for universal in-browser client deployment: 78MB download is cacheable in CacheStorage on first visit. Operates 100% air-gapped on CPU WASM without requiring discrete WebGPU hardware. Produces genuine novel instruction prose from pretraining corpus.

candidates.architecture: Gemma-2 Multi-Head Attention with Sliding Window & Logit Soft-Capping
candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: State-of-the-art local instruction following and task-specific generation. However, 1.42 GB download bandwidth and 2.4 GB VRAM ceiling make it unsuitable as default cold-start for mobile or constrained clients. Qualified as high-capability opt-in progressive enhancement.

candidates.modelName: Gemini Nano (Chrome Built-in AI Prompt API)
candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Optimal web zero-cost profile: zero download bandwidth and zero client bundle size overhead since model weights reside in the browser runtime. 100% offline air-gap guaranteed by browser sandbox. Limitation: strictly restricted to Chrome 131+ desktop/Android; unsupported in Safari, Firefox, or Node.js.

candidates.modelName: SPE-Ω Core A Research Fixture (593 KB ONNX)
candidates.architecture: Causal MLP & Embedding Layer (320 token vocabulary)
candidates.tradeOffAnalysis: Successfully demonstrates local in-browser WASM tensor execution, token decoding, and authentic runtime failure triggering (F02). However, weights are initialized randomly and rely on hand-configured token transitions. It does NOT possess learned language competence and cannot generate open-ended original instructions for arbitrary unseen briefs. Correctly reclassified as RESEARCH_FIXTURE_ONLY.

comparativeRankings.rationale: Zero bundle size, zero download latency, native OS integration on Chrome 131+.
Universal cross-browser WASM CPU compatibility, manageable 78MB footprint, genuine learned open-ended instruction following.
Superior reasoning and prose synthesis; gated behind progressive download confirmation.
Retained for local tensor pipeline verification; explicitly disqualified as production language generator.

verdictNotice: Per SPE Ω Release Rules, DUAL_CORE_QUALIFIED status is strictly withheld until candidate model weights (SmolLM-135M / Gemini Nano) are integrated and qualified across independent held-out benchmarks without template fallbacks.
